canonical_title: How the Designer Checks Each Rule of Evidence

one_line_answer.text: The assessment designer checks whether evidence meets the criteria of each rule of evidence.

cites.quote: To help determine if evidence meets the above criteria, the Assessment designer will need to check
Rules of Evidence As an Assessor

keywords.bn: বৈধতা: সব criteria পূরণ করে কিনা

bangla_explanation: Evidence নেওয়ার আগে designer প্রতিটি rule আলাদা করে check করেন।
Validity মানে evidence-এ সব performance criteria, elements আর dimensions of competency থাকতে হবে।
Authenticity মানে কাজটা candidate নিজে করেছে, অন্য কেউ নয়; সন্দেহ হলে more direct evidence নিন।
Sufficiency-র জন্য একাধিক method ও একাধিক পরিস্থিতি লাগে; সাধারণত তিন ধরনের evidence যথেষ্ট।

example.en: A trainee shows an old oral thermometer certificate. Now digital ear thermometers are standard. The evidence is not current.
example.bn: পুরনো পদ্ধতির প্রমাণ এখন current নয়।

list_answer.title: How the designer checks each rule of evidence
list_answer.title_bn: Designer যেভাবে প্রতিটি rule of evidence যাচাই করেন

items.text: Validity: covers all criteria, elements, dimensions, evidence guide items and range statement musts.

cites.quote: The assessment method you choose must meet all the benchmarks or criteria requirements.
All performance criteria • All elements • Dimensions of competency • Considerations of the Bangladesh NTVQF
Essential skills and knowledge that are listed in the evidence guide • Critical evidence listed in the evidence guide • All of the 'musts' in the range statement.

items.text: Sufficiency: collect evidence more than once, assess all parts, use more than one method.

cites.quote: Collecting evidence more than once and in more than one situation
Making sure the tools and methods assess all parts of the competency standard
Using more than one method of assessment to ensure sufficient evidence

items.text: Currency: evidence shows the person has current, up to date skills and knowledge.

cites.quote: The evidence that will be collected needs to show the person has current skills and knowledge.
It is certain that the person has knowledge that is up to date and current.

items.text: Authenticity: the evidence is work the person produced or created themselves.

cites.quote: The evidence collected from the person for assessment must be work they have produced or created themselves

items_bn: Validity মানে evidence যেন সব benchmarks ঢাকে — criteria, elements, dimensions, evidence guide আর range statement-এর জরুরি অংশ।
যথেষ্ট evidence পেতে একবারের বেশি আর একাধিক method-এ evidence নিতে হয়, আর কাজের সব অংশ assess করতে হয়।
Evidence দেখাবে candidate-এর skills ও knowledge এখনও up to date, পুরনো নয়।
Evidence-টা candidate নিজেই তৈরি করেছে, অন্য কেউ নয় — এটা নিশ্চিত করতে হয়।

traps.text: Extra, Recency: is the evidence less than three years old?

cites.quote: d) Recency Is the evidence less than three years old?

traps.text: Extra rule, Consistency: the candidate consistently meets the standards under work place conditions.

cites.quote: show that the candidate consistently meets the standards under work place conditions?

traps.text: Validity: meet all the benchmarks or criteria requirements. Sufficiency: enough to make a decision about competence.

cites.quote: The assessment method you choose must meet all the benchmarks or criteria requirements.
The evidence collected will be sufficient [enough] to make a decision about a person's competence.

traps.text: Indirect evidence like work samples needs an authenticity check. If in doubt, collect more direct evidence.

cites.quote: When designing assessment tools that use indirect evidence, e.g. work samples you need to ensure that the assessors check on authenticity.
You should collect more direct evidence if in doubt.

short.prompt: What procedures can help establish authenticity of evidence?
short.modelAnswer:
Authentic evidence is work the person produced or created themselves. Procedures to ensure authenticity:
1. Observation of work in progress
2. Declarations
3. Drafting
4. Third party validation
These can be collected via videoing, recording, written transcripts, sign-off sheets and testimonials.

viva.prompt: What must collected evidence include if the benchmark is a unit of competency?

answer.text: All performance criteria, all elements, dimensions of competency, and evidence guide requirements.

checks.note: Recency: CBLM 11 p.23 says "less than three years old"; CBLM 12 p.20 (rules-of-evidence card) says "less than five years old". Card follows CBLM 11. A human should decide which the exam expects.

CBLM 11 p.22 currency example says a supervisor's report "written five years ago" may not be current, while its own recency rule (p.23) is three years. Not strictly a contradiction (currency is not recency), but learners may mix them.

paper-short-questions-q48 answer guide (elements, performance criteria, dimensions, evidence guide skills/critical evidence, range statement musts) matches this CBLM 11 p.22 validity list. The CBLM 12 rules-of-evidence card flagged q48 as not matching CBLM 12 p.20, so this card is the better source for q48.

Aligned with decisions.md (2026-11-01): learners write four rules (Valid, Sufficient, Current, Authentic). CBLM 11 p.22 names five and describes six; Recency and Consistency are taught as extra in traps.
